source_title: ‘RSS Friends’ enters US foreign-agent register, cites concerns over portrayal of Sangh
source_excerpt: A group of Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) well-wishers has registered with the US Department of Justice (DoJ) as a foreign agent representing the organisation. The group, named RSS Friends, aims to expand outreach in the US and respond to information it considers inaccurate or lacking relevant context.The group registered under the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA) on August 27, listing the RSS at Keshavkunj, New Delhi, as its âforeign principalâ. It also listed participation in educational, cultural, community and informational events among its proposed activities.âConsistent with its governing documents and applicable law, it may communicate with members of the public, journalists, media organisations, researchers, academic and policy institutions, community leaders, civil-society organisations, and, where appropriate, government agencies or officials,â RSS Friends said.The filing describes the RSS as an India-based volunteer and social-cultural organisation.
